text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? A tournament notice? "National Sevens Team Championship"—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: A "team battle," is it? Heh-heh... A splendid opportunity to test out new strategies.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: First, I must assemble the cast. An elite vanguard befitting the script.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —And that is why I have gathered all of you here today. Welcome to the "Strongest Team."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: So we're deciding the strongest in Sevens! Leave it to us!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: As a member of this team, I shall fulfill my duty.

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: The game is Sevens... is it? ...And you want me for that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Without question. Each and every one of you will serve as a cornerstone in my grand design.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: First, let us play a round of Sevens among ourselves. Allow me to demonstrate the blueprint I have envisioned.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Very well. Let us test our mettle while getting acquainted.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Then, starting with me... 8 of Diamonds.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hold on, you can play it with far more confidence. Your intimidating aura can serve as a formidable deterrent.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Turning it into psychological warfare, I see. There may indeed be situations where a bluff proves useful.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Yes, I appreciate how quickly you grasp the concept. If we maintain constant pressure, psychological agitation will surely induce more mistakes from our opponents.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Apply pressure, you say... Understood. If that is what is required—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Is there none among you who dares follow my 8 of Diamonds? If you possess the courage to step forward, state your name!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: However, do not expect to leave unscathed. Face me in single combat!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Ooh, what intensity! That is precisely what I was looking for!

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: I can play. 9 of Diamonds. ...How's that?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Taiho possesses the strength to remain completely unphased by her opponents. A sturdy body houses an equally sturdy spirit!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You brush aside my pressure, do you? Fascinating. I accept your challenge. 10 of Diamonds!

text_block_list.name: Title Holder
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's push each other higher! Jack of Diamonds!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hey—!? W-Wait, wait! You're slamming them down with way too much force! This isn't Menko, you know...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I refuse to be bested in sheer momentum! Queen of Diamonds!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
They're not listening to me at all...!
Ugh... fine then, Epi, Eff.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Show me what you've got this time.
Show me that power unburdened by common sense!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ruler.
I'm already out of cards, right?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Look, Spade 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1!
I'm done!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall follow in Epi-san's footsteps.
Heart 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1...
My hand is empty.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...?!?!?
...Y-You just seized victory out of nowhere?!
You two truly are beyond the realm of common sense.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
However, it's not your turn forever.
You can't just play that many cards in a single go!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
But if you can play them, you totally should!
The voice of destiny says so too!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text: I, too, shall proceed in the direction Epi-san points toward.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, right... fair enough.
Then we're wrapping up for today!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What the hell... what is with these guys~~?!
How am I supposed to control this lineup?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Everyone just does whatever they want~~!
And what on earth was with Epi and Eff's hand at the end?!
There's zero reproducibility, so I can't build that into any strategy!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Their quirks far exceed their actual skill~!
Ugwaaaahhhhh~~~~!!
choice_data_list: You seem troubled, are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I am NOT alright at all!
Forget it, I'm going home!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...I'll go home and devise a strategy.
No matter what, I will take first place...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
!!
*ahem*... No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Just a few minor irregularities, you see... but it's fine.
I can formulate a plan... absolutely............
